mLocKeys.keySummary:
Passive: Rell gains out of combat Move Speed.

Active: Rell and an ally gain ramping Move Speed, doubled toward enemies and each other. Her next Attack explodes, dealing magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Rell and an ally charge, gaining <speed>@MinMS*100@% Move Speed</speed>, increased to <speed>@MaxMS*100@%</speed> when facing enemy champions or each other for @Duration@ seconds. Rell's next Attack or <spellName>{{Spell_RellQ_Name}}</spellName> explodes in an area for <magicDamage>@MaxHealthDamageCalc@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Damage capped at @PercentHealthDamageCap@ against jungle monsters and structures.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Stunned</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is stunned and unable to move.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Rell's Attacks and Abilities deal additional magic damage and steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Rell's Attacks and Abilities steal <scaleArmor>@StealPercent*100@% Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>@StealPercent*100@% Magic Resist</scaleMR> for @ShredDuration@ seconds. Max: @MaxPercentTooltipOnly@%. Basic attacks deal <magicDamage>@OnHitDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> on-hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_RellP_Tooltip}}

Always steals at least @StealFloor@. Does not steal from minions or Epic jungle monsters.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Break The Mold</titleLeft><mainText>Rell has stolen Armor and Magic Resist from her enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Break The Mold</titleLeft><mainText>Rell has stolen Armor and Magic Resist from this unit.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Rell thrusts her lance, <status>Stunning</status> targets for @StunDuration@ seconds, destroying all <shield>Shields</shield>, and dealing <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage.</magicDamage>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Magnet Storm</titleLeft><mainText>Rell is Dragging in all nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies toward herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies toward herself for a short while, dealing magic damage over time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently <status>Pulling</status> nearby enemies towards herself. Then Rell constantly <status>Drags</status> nearby enemies towards herself and deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over the next @Duration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Dragged</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is slowly being dragged towards Rell (does not interrupt movement or casts).</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Magnet Storm</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is being pulled towards Rell.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Mounted Charge</titleLeft><mainText>Rell runs faster towards enemy champions and her next attack will flip the target.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Mounted: Rell Dismounts, crashing down in her armor, Knocking enemies up and gaining a large Shield. While dismounted, she gains Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Attack Range, but is Slowed.

Dismounted: Rell forms her Mount, gaining a burst of speed and Knocking Up the next enemy she attacks.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive - Mounted Alacrity: Rell gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountedMoveSpeed@ Move Speed while mounted.

Active - {{Spell_RellW_Dismount_Name}}: Rell leaps off her mount, Knocking Up enemies and dealing @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountDamage@ magic damage. Rell gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:Shield@ Shield, which lasts until she remounts.

Rell then enters her armored form, gaining @spell.RellW_Dismount:ResistanceIncrease*100@% increased Armor and Magic Resist, @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedASBoost*100@% Attack Speed and @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedRangeBoost@ Attack Range. In this armored form, she can use {{Spell_RellW_MountUp_Name2}}.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_RellW_Dismount_Tooltip}}

Active - {{Spell_RellW_MountUp_Name2}}: Rell mounts up and briefly gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountUpSpeed*100@% Decaying Move Speed. Her next Attack within @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountUpSpeedDuration@ seconds Knocks Up and throws enemies behind her, dealing an additional @spell.RellW_Dismount:FlipDamage@ magic damage.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ferromancy: Armored</titleLeft><mainText>Rell gains increased Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Attack Range while armored but moves slowly.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Shielded</titleLeft><mainText>When Rell transforms her mount into her heavy armor, she gains a shield that lasts until broken or she transforms back.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
